about: Jalgaon's city heat action plan: what its public sources confirm (developers, launch, ward-level mapping, thresholds, early warning). Staged so that nothing about the plan reaches a page unless its source holds the terms.

Jalgaon's 'Heat Action Plan' Shows Results As White Roof Coating Lowers Indoor Temperatures

claims.text: Jalgaon City Municipal Corporation developed Jalgaon's heat action plan with Mahila Housing Trust.
The University of Toronto India Foundation and Mahila Housing Trust supported heat action planning in Jalgaon.
The plan includes ward-level heat vulnerability mapping.
The plan sets locally calibrated heat thresholds.
The plan includes an early warning and response framework.
The plan was launched in August 2026.
Under the plan, Jalgaon Municipal Corporation coated roofs of small homes with heat-reflective white paint, starting with a pilot.
